subject.title: [Bug]: non_deliverable_terminal_turn produces no outbound notification to channel plugins — Octo (and other channels) go silent

question: Should `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` bypass `message_tool_only` suppression as a narrow core fallback, or should OpenClaw expose a plugin-owned terminal-failure hook instead?
rationale: Both choices change user-visible channel delivery semantics, and the SDK-hook option changes the public plugin contract, so automation should not choose the permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, after the linked PR supplies proof and focused coverage.

options.title: Add a plugin SDK terminal hook
options.body: OpenClaw adds a documented callback so channel plugins control fallback delivery, accepting new public API surface and per-plugin adoption work.

options.title: Keep message-tool-only strict
options.body: Core rejects automatic fallback delivery in this mode and leaves visible recovery to plugin-owned paths or the broader delivery-contract issue.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, after the linked PR supplies proof and focused coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the auto-reply and follow-up delivery files whose contract would change.
